what: Over the dark curtain covering the hero, a large wordmark stands fitted to 95% of the cell width (half the screen width), then after 1.5s, during the 1.2s in which the cell widens from 50% → 100%, the letter size grows every frame along with the cell to fill the screen width, and the curtain folds up (height 100% → 0) revealing the video·photo below from the bottom up — curve cubic-bezier(.65,.05,0,1). fx:grow at start, fx:done at end

options.delay: Wait before growing (seconds), default 1.5 — meanwhile the character reveal (line-rise split: chars) plays
options.dur: Growth duration (seconds), default 1.2 — 0 jumps straight to the end shape
options.fill: Width ratio of the cell the text fills, default .95
options.[data-fx-part=wrap · title · veil]: Growing cell · text inside the cell (one line) · a mask that folds up above it (if absent, only the text grows)
options.fx:grow · fx:done: Grow start and end events — hook the job of turning on the headline .45s later onto fx:grow

note: Font size is refit by ResizeObserver whenever the cell changes — it fits the screen width even when the window is resized

from.where: index.html .mj-loader — original preparePageLoader·runPageLoader: .header-title-wrap 50% → 100%, .p-loader__bg height 100% → 0, after 1.5s 1.2s navEase, header line opacity 0 → 1 starting .45s later over .8s power2.out, wordmark is data-fit-width (95% of the cell)
